The archive records the county server's original Last-Modified as 'Wed, 06 Nov 2024 07:18:16 GMT' (1:18 AM CST, election night); PDF CreationDate D:20241106003918-06'00'; page footer 'Precinct Summary - 11/06/2024 12:37 AM 1 of 2,809 Report generated with Electionware'. Page 1 header (font-shifted text, decoded): 'Summary Results Report General and Special Election November 5th, 2024 SOVC 117 of 117 Voter Centers Reporting Collin County UNOFFICIAL RESULTS PCT 001'; columns 'TOTAL VOTE % Election Day Early Voting Ballot by mail Limited'; row 'Rep Donald J. Trump/JD Vance 1,032 54.26% 119 886 27 0'. Recorded as check 2 (archived upload time plus printed run time, both on election night; the capture itself is from after election night). So per-precinct candidate votes including election-day votes were uploaded on election night. Only this one precinct file is known; earlier election-night precinct postings, if any, were not archived, so the result is END. County totals: 'Combined Election Day and Early Ballots--Accumulated Totals-Unofficial Final.pdf', original Last-Modified 'Wed, 06 Nov 2024 06:40:17 GMT' (12:40 AM CST), printed 11/06/2024 12:24 AM.

Trump/JD Vance 1,032 54.26% 119 886 27 0'. All quoted, including the footer 'Precinct Summary - 11/06/2024 12:37 AM 1 of 2,809 Report generated with Electionware', match the saved text sample. County totals 00:40 CT (Combined Accumulated Totals, orig_last_modified 06:40:17 GMT, printed 12:24 AM) also confirmed; saved copy 20241106223208_8828ee08c6d4.pdf is a summary with no PCT pages. This does not change the tag or the confidence (low either way, since only one election is determined), but if the build treats check 3 as high-confidence evidence it should not here.
